quest.title: Trouble With Letters
quest.description: Due to the meteor shower, Jiayi's plans to return home to see his family have been canceled yet again. He is looking for someone to send a letter to Qingce Village...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Essence x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* What shall I do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: You must have seen those meteorites that fell from the sky as well, right? Fortunately, the city wasn't hit, but it's a real mess out there in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Not only have the meteorites blocked the roads, but they've also caused the nearby monsters to become more agitated and dangerous than usual, and they've been attacking passers-by and merchants everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs has sent almost every single available Millelith out, but Liyue is far too large. We can only ensure the safety of a few main roads and some key villages.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I'd applied to go to Qingce Village to take up guard duties there, but for some reason, I still got redeployed here to stand by for orders...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you help me send this letter to a girl named Little Liu who lives in Qingce Village?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: She's my daughter, and I'd agreed to go back to spend a few days with her. But with this emergency cropping up, there's no way that'll happen now...

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Much appreciated, Traveler. Ah, what horrible luck...

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: That said, I've heard from people who've come to stand down from duty that quite a few monsters have gathered near Qingce Village as well.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Well... I don't mean to impose, but you do look dressed for adventure.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Could you have a look around Qingce Village while you're sending the letter, and help to clear the monsters out?

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: The Millelith largely stand guard on the main roads and key passes... Things could go poorly if some scattered monsters were able to sneak into Qingce Village.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Thank you! I truly appreciate it.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Well, um... Don't worry, I will arrange fair compensation for you.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: I know, but... I just don't get it. Why does something happen every time I try to apply for leave?

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: I'm finding it hard to call it a coincidence...

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Well, I'll leave it to you then. Please help me get this letter to Little Liu.

talks.objective: Clear out the monsters near Qingce Village

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, do you know where she is?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, well then, guess we'll just have to ask the villagers.

talks.objective: Clear out the monsters near Qingce Village

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: That's so weird. Why does something happen every time Daddy applies for leave?

talks.objective: Deliver Jiayi's letter to Little Liu
Ask the villagers about Little Liu's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any idea where Little Liu is?

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: Little Liu? Hmm, I remember her saying that she wanted to find a high place so she could watch the meteorites...

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think she <color=#00E1FFFF>climbed up those ladders over there</color>.

talks.objective: Ask the villagers about Little Liu's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you where Little Liu is?

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: Little Liu? We were going to meet here to watch the meteorites, but she said that she wanted to find someplace higher.

dialogues.speaker: Dongdong
dialogues.text: She said that she'd tell me once she found our new spot, but I don't know where she's gone.

talks.objective: Ask the villagers about Little Liu's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about Little Liu...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Ghast
dialogues.text: Little Liu... Little Liu... Ah yes, I know her. But I've been here all this while, and she didn't pass this way.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: I should be able to see the meteorites clearly from here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's a letter for you...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: A letter from Daddy... Ugh, I already know what it's going to say...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: He can't come and spend time with me because of work, right?

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: When those Millelith came here, I thought Daddy would be with them, but that didn't happen...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: But that's not a bad thing, actually. With all those rocks falling from the sky, Daddy could be in danger out there.

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: Well... a little, but we should be alright. The Millelith are here, after all.

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: Right! Could you send this letter back to Daddy for me? He must be worried.

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: It's so strange. Something seems to happen every time Daddy says he'll take leave and spend time with me...

response.speaker: Little Liu
response.text: I know, I know. The Millelith have talked our ears off already.

talks.objective: Give Jiayi's letter to Little Liu

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. I'll keep this for the time being. This is not the time to be reading letters... I must attend to my duties now.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Please take this as compensation for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Once this is all over, I'm taking a long break for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will I finally be able to clear my leave...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: You're back. Did you manage to deliver the letter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did. Little Liu has a letter for you too, by the by.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Little Liu wrote me a letter? Let me see...
